KaTeX (MIT license) and KaTeX fonts, copied from the locally installed OpenAI VS Code extension 26.908.40401-linux-x64.
Source: webview/assets/katex-ce1e5fbd580e.js and the KaTeX section of app-initial-ddb6c251267b.css.
The self-contained ESM file has its unavailable sourcemap reference removed and its default export exposed as window.katex inside a private function, to support opening this demo without an HTTP server. The stylesheet retains WOFF2 fonts only.
KaTeX: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
